items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: Mox was in the same time. Mox, another homeboy.

ctx.x: Oh, he had banjo or guitarist. Yeah, well, I got reinforced those country bands. I was bunking the Black Eagle band too for a while. Yeah, uh-huh. With you, same time as you? No, not same time.
Later, I guess. Mox was in the same time. Mox, another homeboy. Yeah. Yeah, sack of mute.
T-Boy was playing with that band once too. Where's T-Boy? T-Boy Rene? You know, you remember Johnny French, bro?
